labels.species: Neutropenic female Swiss-Webster mice 24-26 g; intranasal P. aeruginosa PAO1 2 × 10^7 CFU
labels.record_level: Reported population PK/PD parameters with Mean, Median and SD; no individual concentration or regimen-level response records supplied.
labels.endpoint_window: PK: 11 times over 0-5 h; lungs harvested 24 h after the start of therapy; reported ELF targets expressed as percentages of the dosing interval.
labels.reason: The body contains numerical PK/PD parameter summaries, including Vc/F, CL/F, VELF and bacterial-model parameters. Notes supply PK and efficacy designs, strain MIC and reported ELF targets. These support partial input and provenance matches only. Concentrations are explicitly not transcribed; parameter summaries do not establish measured CFU responses, individual variability, free exposure or independently validated targets. Numeric-column units vary by Parameter row and have no common stated unit.

evidence.quote: Population PK/PD parameters, P. aeruginosa pneumonia model (plasma and ELF)
S06 | DOI 10.1128/aac.01559-10 | Table 2 (Drusano et al. 2011)

Neutropenic female Swiss-Webster mice 24-26 g (cyclophosphamide 150 mg/kg day -4 and 100 mg/kg day -1 i.p.); intranasal P. aeruginosa PAO1 2 × 10^7 CFU. PK: single i.p. doses spanning 2.4-150 mg/kg given to four groups 5 h after inoculation (individual doses not listed); 11 times over 0-5 h, 2-3 mice per time; plasma and urea-corrected BAL (ELF) by LC-MS/MS.

Efficacy: "Five animal cohorts were administered meropenem i.p. at doses of 50, 100, 150, 200, 300, and 450 mg/kg every 4 h" (five cohorts but six doses, as printed) from 5 h after inoculation; lungs harvested 24 h after the start of therapy. Mice per cohort not stated; 5 mice killed for baseline counts.
Concentrations are in Figs. 1-2 only (not transcribed). Vc/F and CL/F are per animal (liters, liters/h), not per kg. Protein binding not reported. Table read once from the journal HTML.

Text: ELF penetration about 40% (median 39%); exposure targets "31.7%, 49.6%, and 49.8% of the dosing interval" time > MIC in ELF (abstract: 32%, 50%, 50%); endpoint mapping (2-log kill, 3-log kill, resistance suppression) paraphrased, NOT_VERIFIED. Strain MIC 0.5 to 1.0 mg/L.

findings.reason: MI001 remains OPEN, status NOT_FOUND, needed_at adequacy. A90 supplies efficacy design and baseline sample count, while A94:A110 supply reported parameters rather than per-regimen measured CFU responses. Regimen-response-exposure matching required by DR018 and MC012 is not established. No observations may be reconstructed from the fitted summaries.
findings.needed_material: At the adequacy review, assess authorized regimen-level responses, baseline and untreated growth-control values, response definitions and traceable exposure links; otherwise explicitly retain the limitation and keep independent index comparison unresolved. This label does not close MI001.

findings.reason: A90 states Five animal cohorts but lists six efficacy doses and explicitly flags the inconsistency. Mice per efficacy cohort are not stated. Neither the cohort count nor a dose-to-cohort allocation can be adopted silently.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported clarification of efficacy cohort membership, dose allocation and animal counts; retain both printed counts pending review.

findings.reason: MI008 remains OPEN, status DEFERRED, needed_at pk. The table reports Mean, Median and SD, and A89 reports 2-3 mice per sampling time, but supplies no verified animal identifiers, individual concentration records or explanation establishing whether parameter SD represents empirical interindividual variability or another source of dispersion. Parameter summaries do not resolve DR010.
findings.needed_material: During PK assessment, establish experimental units, sampling structure and the provenance and interpretation of parameter variability; distinguish it from estimation uncertainty and carry any limitation to later PTA.

findings.reason: A89 supplies sampling design, route, dose range and matrices, but individual PK doses are not listed. A91 explicitly states that concentration figures are not transcribed. This page therefore provides design metadata and reported parameters, not concentration-time observations for independent modeling. No detection limits or observation-level missingness information are supplied.
findings.needed_material: Authorized source-linked concentrations with times, actual group doses, dose timing, experimental-unit structure, assay-limit metadata and extraction provenance, or a downstream decision documenting parameter-only exploratory use.

findings.reason: Numerical Vc/F, CL/F and VELF summaries support registration of systemic and ELF parameter evidence. They do not establish component eligibility, identifiable model structure or predictive performance. The source supplies no transcribed concentration curves for those assessments.
findings.needed_material: Animal PK review of the reported model definitions and available authorized underlying evidence, recording component-specific eligibility or exploratory-only use without treating this label as approval.

findings.reason: A95 and B95:D95 report CL/F with Mean 0.0198, Median 0.0179 and SD 0.00549 in liters/h. A91 states the parameter is per animal. This is an apparent-clearance literature candidate; applicable bioavailability, detailed estimation method and independent concentration evidence are not supplied. It cannot establish absolute CL.
findings.needed_material: If clearance is selected, retain LITERATURE_REPORTED, NOT_RECALCULATED and NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED status; obtain source parameter definitions, estimation context and applicable F before any absolute-clearance interpretation.

findings.reason: Meropenem, i.p. administration, body-weight-normalized doses and per-animal Vc/F and CL/F are stated. Chemical dose basis and total-versus-unbound concentration basis are not stated. The page does not explicitly specify unchanged meropenem versus another analytical composition. A91 explicitly states protein binding is not reported.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported formulation and analyte-composition definitions, dose basis and matrix-specific total/free basis before dependent dose calculations or translation. Preserve per-animal parameters separately from mg/kg doses.

findings.reason: A89 identifies P. aeruginosa PAO1 and A92 reports Strain MIC 0.5 to 1.0 mg/L. The range does not identify a single summary value for analysis. Measurement method, medium, testing standard, replicate count and explanation of the range are not supplied.
findings.needed_material: Authorized strain-matched MIC measurement context and the documented value or uncertainty representation to use; do not choose a range endpoint or substitute a distribution.

findings.reason: A92 supplies source-reported percentage-of-interval time > MIC targets in ELF, but does not state a free-exposure basis. Binding is not reported, concentrations are not transcribed, and the source does not establish the full exposure window, MIC selection or matched response mapping needed for the project's fT>MIC comparison.
findings.needed_material: Explicit free-exposure or binding inputs, source-linked exposure profiles, matched MIC, exposure window and regimen-response mapping before calculating or comparing fT>MIC.

findings.reason: A90 lists efficacy doses at the same every 4 h interval. This page does not document a frequency- or interval-varying design that separates the candidate exposure indices. PK used single doses in a separately described experiment; compatibility with repeated-dose efficacy exposures is not established.
findings.needed_material: Authorized regimen design and PK-to-PD exposure linkage sufficient to assess index separation and experimental compatibility; otherwise retain index ranking as unresolved without blocking independent PK tasks.

findings.reason: A92 reports 31.7%, 49.6% and 49.8%, alongside abstract values 32%, 50% and 50%. It explicitly marks the mapping to 2-log kill, 3-log kill and resistance suppression as paraphrased, NOT_VERIFIED. ELF penetration lacks an explicit ratio denominator and concentration-versus-AUC definition. These are reported source statements, not accepted project targets.
findings.needed_material: Verify each target's endpoint mapping, reference, exposure definition, window, free/total basis, uncertainty and applicability. Preserve all printed values without reconciling them. The planned T04 target output for T06 remains deferred and requires its own qualification and freeze.

findings.reason: The reported ELF targets in A92 have identifiable source provenance through A88. Under R013 they cannot determine primary-analysis starting values, bounds, priors or rankings, and their presence does not supply an independent index comparison.
findings.needed_material: Retain the targets as source-reported contextual evidence and document independent provenance for any later primary-analysis initialization, constraints and ranking rule.
